summary.zh-Hans: 秦始皇陵的兵马俑遗址于1974年被发现。陶俑形态各异，与陶马、战车等共同构成重要的考古遗存。
summary.en: Discovered in 1974, the Terracotta Army at the First Qin Emperor’s mausoleum includes individually varied figures, horses and chariots.

summary.zh-Hans: 西安现存城墙修建于明代。沿城墙游览，可以看到城内街景、护城河与城楼。
summary.en: Xi’an’s surviving city wall dates to the Ming dynasty. A walk along it offers views of the city, moat and watchtowers.

summary.zh-Hans: 西安的腊汁肉夹馍将肉与白吉馍搭配在一起，饼香与软嫩的肉馅相互衬托。
summary.en: Xi’an’s lazhi roujiamo pairs tender meat with baiji flatbread.

summary.zh-Hans: 羊肉泡馍将碎馍与羊肉汤结合，是西安的代表性美食之一。
summary.en: Yangrou paomo combines pieces of flatbread with lamb soup and is a specialty of Xi’an.
